headline: Earnings surge y/y as EIX reaffirms multi-year outlook
summary_short: Q2 net income rose 63.6% y/y to $561M and diluted EPS climbed 55.1% y/y to $1.38, even as revenue of $4.36B fell 4.1% y/y (+6.2% q/q); EIX reaffirmed its 2026-2028 Core EPS guidance.
summary_long: Revenue of $4.36B fell 4.1% y/y (+6.2% q/q) while gross profit rose 19.0% y/y, operating income climbed 40.9% y/y to $1.09B, net income rose 63.6% y/y to $561M, and diluted EPS gained 55.1% y/y to $1.38. The filed exhibit is Edison International's business-update investor deck, not a quarterly MD&A, so it states no line-item cause for the quarter's revenue or cost moves. The company reaffirmed full-year Core EPS guidance of $5.90-6.20 for 2026, $6.25-6.65 for 2027, and $6.74-7.14 for 2028, underpinned by a $38-41B 2026-2030 capital plan and ~7% projected SCE rate-base CAGR, with no equity issuance planned through 2030.
